issue.subject: Fibre plant and ONU/CPE device faults are routed to the responsible team
issue.description:
NOC-AUTO S6

**Statement:** As a NOC engineer, I need a ticket with a fibre plant fault or a faulty ONU/CPE routed to the responsible team (Passive-Infra, LANOps or NOC) with the findings in the comment, so that the right team acts without a manual hand-off.

**PRD:** https://rnd.frontiir.net/en/products/rt/requirements/noc-ticket-automation-prd

**ACs (6):**

- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC13` CA1 or uplink broken: When CA1 or the uplink is broken the ticket moves to Passive-Infra with the matching fields, status and comment, and the automation takes no further action on it.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC14` CA1 or uplink low signal: When CA1 or the uplink has low signal the ticket moves to Passive-Infra with the matching fields, status and comment, and the automation takes no further action on it.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC20` ONU down: When the ONU is not working and was last seen over 12 hours ago the ticket moves to LANOps with the matching fields, status and comment.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC21` Low dBm: When the ONU is working but rx power is outside -27 to -8 dBm the ticket moves to LANOps with the matching fields, status and comment.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC22` Swap ONU: When the ONU is working but TX power, bias, voltage or temperature is out of range the ticket moves to LANOps with the matching fields, status and comment.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC23` ONU up, CPE down: When the ONU is up and the CPE is down the ticket moves to NOC with the matching fields and comment.

**Open points:**

- AC21: Comment text differs between the two tickets; use #21613.

**Implementation status:** code exists on the feature branch, unvalidated. Tasks to be refined by Dev after the Story is agreed.

**Related (reference only):** #21613, #22265
